data.name: Panic Pub
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO PANIC PUB!

You and your friends run the pub. Serve drinks, cook food, manage orders, and keep the customers happy. Sounds easy enough. Until your pub gets busy and someone gets angry enough to turn into a bear and beat you up.

THE BETTER THE PUB, THE WORSE IT GETS!

Start small and build your dream pub. Unlock new cocktails, serve more food, attract more customers, and take on busier shifts. The more your pub grows, the more there is to manage.

KEEP YOUR COOL!

Work together to survive the rush. One of you can serve drinks while another cooks, cleans, or handles the customers. Communication helps, but things rarely go exactly as planned.

SOME CUSTOMERS HAVE A SHORT FUSE!

Keep your customers happy and the night might go smoothly. Keep them waiting too long, and you might have a much bigger problem on your hands.

KEY FEATURES

  • Up to 4-player local and online co-op

  • Build and upgrade your pub

  • Cocktails, food, and increasingly busy shifts

  • Chaotic customer behavior and random events

  • Solo play or co-op with friends

  • Full controller support
